title: LEGO® MARVEL Super Heroes
provenance: Reported by DCD55 (highball-db#836, 2026-10-31), Apple M5, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK with async shaders on, esync, a 60 fps cap, DLL overrides d3d9=n,b and d3d11=n,b, Emulate display mode on, an Xbox controller, rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes: the first level at 60 fps. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The first level plays at 60 fps on DXVK on an M5 with an Xbox controller. The reporter needed -novid to get past the intro videos, and in-engine cutscenes miss some textures. Not measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The game freezes on its intro videos (M5, DXVK)
knownIssues.fix: add -novid to the game's launch arguments, as the reporter did

knownIssues.symptom: In-engine cutscenes draw without some floor and background textures (M5, DXVK)

knownIssues.fix: turning on V-Sync in the game fixed it for the reporter
